UTC Time Converter for Shortwave Schedules

Shortwave schedules use UTC. Enter a UTC time to see it in your time zone, or a local time to get UTC. Your device's time zone is detected automatically and daylight saving time is handled for you.

Why shortwave uses UTC

Broadcasts cross many time zones, so schedules use one universal clock that never changes for daylight saving. Common offsets: US Eastern is UTC−5 in winter and UTC−4 in summer; US Pacific UTC−8 / −7; UK UTC+0 / +1; Central Europe UTC+1 / +2. More in the UTC glossary entry.

Frequently asked questions

What is 0000 UTC in Eastern time?

In winter (EST) it is 7:00 pm the previous evening; in summer (EDT) it is 8:00 pm the previous evening.

Is UTC the same as GMT?

For listening purposes, yes. UTC is the scientific standard; GMT is the UK's winter civil time, which matches it.
